control_failures.control_label: guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: prohibition notice - work stopped during start-up after maintenance on V-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control BLAST_GUARDING_AND_CLEARANCE: the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast on V-4110, PSV-4110 and PSV-4111 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in storing and transporting explosives, specifically receiving, magazining and reconciling explosives. V-4110 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 6 February 2024 a regulatory notice was issued concerning V-4110, PSV-4110 and PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following start-up after maintenance.
